Exact left/right placement counts, including the duplicated block-start representation, establish all classes, deficits and multiplicities. Direct independent enumerations checked 107355 masks and all associated fixed-pattern/fiber identities; 61125 separately modeled block-placement fiber entries were also checked. The n=2 and absent-pattern boundaries are handled; finite tests alone are not the proof.
